datasets.name: Sentinel-2 MSI-Level 1C
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-2 data, and in particular the collection MSI-Level 1C, were used in this work. The collection represents the reflectance at the Top of the Atmosphere (TOA) and is available within the Google Earth Engine (GEE) Platform [34]. ... This data can be found here: https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/COPERNICUS_S2 (accessed on 15 September 2022).

methods.name: RST-cover
methods.summary: A multitemporal change detection technique based on the Robust Satellite Technique (RST) that uses the ALICE index to identify statistically significant NDVI anomalies at the pixel level, comparing current observations against a historical baseline of clear-sky Sentinel-2 data.
methods.source: Satriano, V.; Ciancia, E.; Filizzola, C.; Genzano, N.; Lacava, T.; Tramutoli, V.
methods.verbatim: The technique proposed in this paper, christened RST-cover, is based on the more general Robust Satellite Technique (RST, [35]).

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory used for validation is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the RST-cover method lacks a repository or persistent link.
